endpoint_gradient_probe.scope: Two strong-augmented B36 batches, frozen raw epoch300 reference weights, CPU FP32 batch BN. Backbone/neck computed without gradients; probe measured shared neck output and classification-tower parameter gradients. No updates or checkpoints.
limitations: Endpoint gradient diagnostic is not full-training or AP evidence.
Pointwise nonnegative QFL scaling does not force alignment after shared-parameter aggregation.
